name: Publish Outbox Event
description: Accepts the intent to publish an event, encodes it into an envelope, and stores it as a pending message in the Outbox store.

files.description: Main publishing path: encode validation, message creation, and storage persistence.
Assigns the envelope id, type, version, sender, and content.
Defines the Outbox persistence contract implemented by an application or adapter.
Defines the pending status used after a message is stored.
